review.reason: Approval is limited to independently inspected ecoinvent 3.9 cut-off hand-lay-up glass-fibre/unsaturated-polyester material and the separately reviewed light-commercial-freight identity. Composite references are positive one kg manufactured material, not a polymer-processing service; the material includes glass fibre and resin. Preserve signed caller material kg, supported uncertainty/formulas, foreground ownership and separate caller emissions/materials at factor +1. Do not add resin/glass again or remove caller-owned independent inputs. Other releases, patches, system models and reverse routes receive no new permission. Use the complete native European hand-lay-up composite once per kg. Both inspected source producers and native releases use nominal 0.632 kg glass fibre, 0.421 kg unsaturated polyester resin and 0.025 kg organic chemicals, with 0.0526 kg mineral-wool waste and 6.25e-5 kg aromatic hydrocarbon emission. These are input/auxiliary quantities, not an inferred finished-product resin/fibre percentage. No density, purity, curing, moisture, material-loss or mass-balance multiplier is invented; do not normalize the input recipe to one kg or add a recovery credit. Source negative-reference waste demand and native positive treatment demand are internal to their complete models; the positive composite reference remains factor +1. Both records explicitly lack direct process-energy data and rely on material-use assumptions from a limited manufacturer sample. Keep that inherited incompleteness visible: absence of an energy exchange is not evidence of physically zero energy. No invented oven, electricity, heat or energy credit is added. The complete native inventory replaces source upstream glass/resin/chemical supply, raw-material transport, waste-treatment geography/moisture/allocation, vintage and internal uncertainty. Nominal material/emission agreement does not establish source/native LCI, LCIA or stochastic equivalence; score effects remain unquantified. Native raw-material freight is separate from the markets retained final delivery. No new source omission, runtime Python module, alternative UVEK sector engine or validation bypass. Other existing profile entries/default targets and all earlier approval fingerprints remain unchanged. Exact component permissions do not authorize another resin, composite technology, freight mode or source profile. Retain both original RER/RoW producer shares separately (0.330592351639303 and 0.669407648360697 kg) and all original final delivery: 0.0246 light-commercial, 0.3857 heavy-road and 1.1439 container-sea tkm per kg. Do not normalize/merge away source shares or add distances, freight loss or loading multipliers. Both producer supplies use complete native European composite as screened proxies; native internal raw-material freight remains unchanged in addition to separately retained final delivery. Light-commercial delivery uses complete native Swiss 3.5t-gross light fleet, heavy unspecified road freight reuses its reviewed European heavy-fleet correspondence, and container sea freight reuses its reviewed ocean service. Light versus heavy mode/vehicle class stays distinct; each service includes its own vehicle, maintenance, disposal and road/port infrastructure. Country/fuel/load/duty/age/fleet and geographic differences, including the Swiss light fleet versus global source supply and container-ship portfolio, remain warnings. No duplicate vehicle, fuel, infrastructure or payload conversion is added.
